items.html: And the Essence of Yetzirah, which has in it NRNHY, all of them called the Ruchin of Yetzirah. And from this coupling of the Essence, the Ruchin of the five aspects are made for human beings. And likewise in the Essence of Beriah, etc., and all are called the Neshamot of Beriah, and from this coupling, etc. And likewise in the Essence of Atzilut there are five aspects of NRNHY, and even the Nefesh which is here is called Neshama-to-Neshama in relation to Beriah. And from this coupling of the Essence, the Neshama-to-Neshama is made for human beings.
